honesty_notes: Revenue cache (.p2_rev_cache.json) ends 2026Q1; 2Q26 actuals + 3Q guidance sourced from IR earnings call (investing.com transcript) + Korean press (betanews/ddaily/inven/newspim).

Proxy coverage is PARTIAL: pcbang=Korea PC only (TOP10-truncated), maple=Korea MapleStory population (headcount not ARPU), DMM=Japan mobile only (Maple M + Blue Archive affiliate). None covers China DnF Mobile or Western PC/console (ARC) except Steam.
Nexon validated proxy strength (per games_summary + p2_validation): DMM Spearman rho 0.62 (nowcast), Steam rho 0.45 (trend), pcbang rho 0.27 (trend, weak). pcbang is DOWNWEIGHTED.
Q3 OI guidance high is reconstructed as 32.3 (a transcript typo printed 22.3; -14% YoY on 3Q25 OI 375.28 = 322.7).

correlations_nexon_revYoY_vs_proxyYoY.note: games_summary Spearman: DMM 0.62 (nowcast), pcbang 0.27 (trend). No single axis linearly predicts total rev; proxies are IP-directional.

layers.L1_anchor: Guidance mid: rev ¥1,270억 / OP ¥275억. But apply Nexon OI-sandbag (2Q beat OI top +24%) -> lean OP toward/above guide top.
layers.L2_proxy: Maple normalizing off record (pop -12% QTD) = QoQ headwind; ARC CCU sustained + Mabinogi Mobile rank2 = new-revenue offset; DnF -44% & FC soft = continuing drag. Net: rev ~flat-to-up QoQ vs 2Q ¥1,211억.
layers.L3_bottomup: Maple down QoQ off record (still healthy YoY); DnF drag continues; FC soft; ARC ~¥18bn stable (biggest support); Mabinogi Mobile ramp; BA soft.

BEAR.thesis: Maple gives back record faster + DnF/FC drag + ARC plateaus, no Mabinogi upside. Rev at guide bottom.

BASE.thesis: ARC stable + Mabinogi Mobile ramp offset Maple normalization; OI at guide TOP (¥323억) per sandbag pattern.

BULL.thesis: ARC accelerates (console/content) + Mabinogi Mobile hit + China DnF summer stabilizes; OI beats guide top like 2Q.

vs_guidance.op_base_position: 상회 (guide 상단 ¥323억 수렴 — OI 언더가이드 관성)

swing_factors: 1) ARC Raiders 궤적: ¥18.3bn/분기 run-rate + CCU 24k(피크근접) 유지 vs 자연감쇠/콘솔·신콘텐츠 램프 — 최대 스윙
2) MapleStory 정상화 속도: 2Q 사상최대(+63%)를 3Q에 얼마나 반납하나 (인구 QTD -12%, 주간 감소 진행)
3) 중국 던파(-44%) 안정화 + Mabinogi Mobile KR 램프(iOS 2위) 지속성
